system.description: You have attracted the attention of another Toreador who has made it her business to see you succeed, whether because of your lineage, your artwork, or something you did or said. She champions your work, speaks up for you in the courts, and may arrange shelter or training. A two-dot Patron is roughly your own station but older and full of good advice; a four-dot Patron commands real resources and occupies a position high enough to make a significant difference in your unlife. Do not take her support for granted — a Patron who feels used will not stop until she has taken back her due.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book One: Artisans (Toreador)
